name: Log4Shell
rootCause: JNDI lookups in log message substitution resolve attacker-controlled strings (e.g. ${jndi:ldap://...}) and load remote code.
impact: Unauthenticated remote code execution on internet-facing Java services.
mitigation: Upgrade to a fixed Log4j release; disable message JNDI lookups; restrict egress.
timeline: Discovered by Chen Zhaojun of Alibaba Cloud Security; disclosed 9 Dec 2021; widely exploited within hours.

name: Heartbleed
rootCause: TLS heartbeat extension trusts attacker-supplied length and reads past the allocated buffer without bounds checking.
impact: Disclosure of process memory including private keys, session tokens and credentials.
mitigation: Upgrade OpenSSL, reissue certificates and rotate all secrets.
timeline: Reported to OpenSSL by Neel Mehta; disclosed 7 Apr 2014.

name: Shellshock
rootCause: Bash parses function definitions from environment variables, executing trailing commands during import.
impact: Remote command execution via CGI and other interfaces that pass environment variables.
mitigation: Patch Bash; avoid passing untrusted data into environment variables.
timeline: Reported by Stéphane Chazelas; disclosed 24 Sep 2014.

name: Apache Struts OGNL Injection
rootCause: OGNL expression evaluation of an attacker-controlled Content-Type header in the file upload interceptor.
impact: Unauthenticated remote code execution; famously exploited in the Equifax breach.
mitigation: Upgrade Struts; validate and restrict Content-Type parsing.
timeline: Disclosed March 2017; mass exploitation followed publication of PoCs.

name: ZeroLogon
rootCause: AES-CFB8 implementation reuses an all-zero initialization vector, enabling probabilistic forgery of the computer credential exchange.
impact: Domain controller machine password reset and potential full domain compromise.
mitigation: Apply MS patches and enforce secure RPC.
timeline: Reported by Tom Tervoort of Secura; patched August 2020.

name: PwnKit
rootCause: pkexec mishandles an empty argument vector, allowing environment variables to be interpreted as executables and library paths.
impact: Any local unprivileged user can gain root on many default Linux distributions.
mitigation: Patch polkit; remove setuid bit where possible.
timeline: Reported by Qualys Research; disclosed 25 Jan 2022.

name: ProxyLogon
rootCause: Front-end Exchange trusts a crafted X-AnimatedContent cookie and authenticates as the backend service.
impact: Mailbox access and, chained with further flaws, remote code execution.
mitigation: Apply Microsoft out-of-band patches; check for compromise.
timeline: Reported by DEV-CORE via Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative; disclosed March 2021.

name: Spring4Shell
rootCause: Data binding of request parameters to a JDK 9+ Class object allows manipulation of class-loader properties and log file writing.
impact: Remote code execution in certain Spring MVC deployments.
mitigation: Upgrade Spring Framework; restrict data binding.

name: F5 BIG-IP Auth Bypass
rootCause: iControl REST skips authentication for requests with certain hop-by-hop headers and an authenticated-like username.
impact: Unauthenticated administrative API access and command execution on vulnerable management interfaces.

name: MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection
rootCause: SQL injection in a web endpoint permits unauthenticated database access and deployment of a web shell.
impact: Large-scale data theft affecting many downstream organizations.
mitigation: Patch; hunt for web shells and IoCs.
timeline: Discovered in May 2023; widely exploited over the following months.

name: Citrix Bleed
rootCause: Improper buffer handling in an authentication endpoint leaks session tokens in HTTP responses.
impact: Hijacking of authenticated sessions without credentials, including after patching if tokens were not reset.
mitigation: Patch and terminate all active sessions.
timeline: Disclosed October 2023; exploited as a zero-day beforehand.

name: XZ Utils Backdoor
rootCause: Malicious code hidden in release tarballs and build scripts alters liblzma behaviour when linked into OpenSSH via a specific patch workflow.
impact: Potential remote code execution in SSH authentication paths on affected distributions.
mitigation: Downgrade to 5.4.x; audit build artifacts and provenance.
timeline: Discovered by Andres Freund in March 2024; rapid global response.

name: BlueKeep
rootCause: Use-after-free in the Remote Desktop Services kernel driver allows pre-authentication code execution.
impact: Wormable RCE over port 3389 without credentials.
mitigation: Patch; disable RDP where unnecessary; enable NLA.
timeline: Discovered by the UK NCSC; patched May 2019.

name: PHP-FPM Underflow RCE
rootCause: An attacker-supplied PATH_INFO causes an underflow in FPM's path handling, leading to environment variable overwrite and code execution.
impact: Remote code execution on common nginx + PHP-FPM configurations.
timeline: Discovered by Andrew Danau andrus at DEF CON 27.

name: Outlook NTLM Coercion
rootCause: A crafted reminder with a UNC path causes Outlook to authenticate to an attacker-controlled SMB share using the user's Net-NTLMv2 hash.
impact: Credential theft and relay attacks against internal systems.
mitigation: Apply patches; block outbound SMB; enable Extended Protection for Authentication.
timeline: Reported by Microsoft Threat Intelligence; patched March 2023.
